LanguageData.TIU_Gun_NADL_Rifle.label: NADL service rifle
LanguageData.TIU_Gun_NADL_Rifle.description: The standard firearm of the Korea Wall (NADL) rapid-response teams. Tuned for stable three-round bursts in cross-border aberrant interdiction. Built to SDAC supply specifications.
LanguageData.TIU_Apparel_WhiteShieldVest.label: White Shield protective vest
LanguageData.TIU_Apparel_WhiteShieldVest.description: Protective gear worn by White Shield / NADL field response teams. Designed to block aberrant melee attacks and environmental contamination at the same time.
LanguageData.TIU_Drug_EVSuppressant.label: EV-Sigma suppressant
LanguageData.TIU_Drug_EVSuppressant.description: A medical suppressant that grants temporary resistance to mutation progression and environmental contamination. A supply-grade reproduction of the standard prescription from Yoon Se-jin's medical/research line.
